_doc: Round 17 — who will walk with you, and the rules about how many of them there can be. js/followers.js reads this file and nothing else does. A mercenary is a COMPANION you bought: a body in the world that fights beside you (js/pets.js), not a citizen who goes and lives at your holding (that is colony.recruitOffer, and it is a different thing entirely). `slots` is the follower ladder, `perType` the summon rule, `scaling` how anybody who follows you keeps up with your level, and `mercenaries` the types a mercenary broker sells.
_slotsDoc: THREE FOLLOWERS AT LEVEL ONE, four at twenty, five at thirty — the user's own ladder. `perk` is a derived stat: the Kept Company arm of the perk forest grants `followerSlots`, and js/perks.js is the only place that number is handed out. Everything that follows you — a class companion, a bought mercenary, a summoned wolf — takes one slot, so the ladder is the one number that decides how big your company can be.
_perTypeDoc: ONE PER TYPE unless the spell that calls it says otherwise. `base` is that one; a summoning skill in data/skills.json may carry its own `count`, which wins; and the Kept Company arm adds its `followerSlots` on top of whichever of those applies. The TOTAL limit above still holds over all of it — five slots and four mercenaries leaves room for exactly one wolf.
_scalingDoc: Everybody who follows you is re-costed off YOUR level every frame js/pets.js runs (see `retune`), so a sentry summoned at level 1 is never still swinging for 1 at level 20. `perLevel` is the same compounding step balance.json uses for a class companion; `pricePerLevel` is how much more a broker charges for somebody who can survive where you are going.
_mercDoc: Each type is a whole body: the numbers js/pets.js builds a unit from, a look, the abilities it casts on its own cooldown, and the upgrades it grows into. `minLevel` keeps a 900-gold caster off a level-2 village's board. `minTownSize` is the settlement size that can support one. `abilities` fire at whatever the follower is already fighting; `upgrades` are read every time the follower is re-costed, so a mercenary hired at level 4 who reaches level 22 has learned everything below 22 by the time you look at them.

mercenaries.name: Blade for Hire
mercenaries.blurb: Somebody's second son with a hanger and no plans. Cheap, and stands where you point.

abilities.name: Heavy Swing
abilities.desc: One committed blow at whatever they are already fighting.

upgrades.note: trades the hanger for a longsword
learns to open a guard
buys plate out of their own pay

mercenaries.name: Shield Warden
mercenaries.blurb: Paid by the hour to be the thing that gets hit. Slow, heavy, and very hard to move.

abilities.name: Shield Check
abilities.desc: Knocks everything around them off its feet.

upgrades.note: takes a kite shield off a dead raider
learns to plant and hold

mercenaries.name: Longshot
mercenaries.blurb: Sits behind you, says nothing, and empties a quiver into whatever you are looking at.

abilities.name: Pinning Bolt
abilities.desc: Puts a shaft through a leg and leaves it there.

upgrades.note: restrings to a war bow
learns to loose three at once

mercenaries.name: Hedge Burner
mercenaries.blurb: Learned the one spell and never learned another. It is, to be fair, a very good spell.

abilities.name: Kindle
abilities.desc: Sets one thing alight and steps back.

abilities.name: Ember Ring
abilities.desc: A ring of fire around whatever they are aiming at.

upgrades.note: learns the ring
burns hotter than anything a village taught them

mercenaries.name: Frost Binder
mercenaries.blurb: Does not kill much. Everything they touch arrives late, which is worse for it.

abilities.name: Rime Burst
abilities.desc: Everything near their target slows to a walk.

upgrades.note: learns to hold a thing still
their rime bites as well as slows

mercenaries.name: Field Mender
mercenaries.blurb: Kills nothing worth counting and is the reason you walked out of the last three fights.

abilities.name: Field Dressing
abilities.desc: Puts a twelfth of your health back, and the same into everyone else who follows you.

abilities.name: Second Wind
abilities.desc: The one they save for when it has gone badly.

upgrades.note: learns what to do when it has gone badly
carries enough for everybody

mercenaries.name: Shadow Knife
mercenaries.blurb: Works the edges of a fight. Never stands where the shield wall is and never gets thanked.

abilities.name: Opened Vein
abilities.desc: A cut that keeps paying out.

upgrades.note: buys a matched pair
learns where the gap in the armour is

mercenaries.name: Galecaller
mercenaries.blurb: Charges anything they hit so that everything else lands harder. Expensive for a reason.

abilities.name: Arc Over
abilities.desc: Jumps between everything standing too close together.

upgrades.note: calls it down instead of across
the storm follows them now

mercenaries.name: Bonesinger
mercenaries.blurb: Nobody asks where they trained. Their curses stick, which is what you are paying for.

abilities.name: Long Curse
abilities.desc: A curse that outlasts the thing wearing it.

upgrades.note: learns to take health back with it
curses everything in the same breath

mercenaries.name: Houndmaster
mercenaries.blurb: Comes with the dog. The dog is the expensive half and they will tell you so.

abilities.name: Set On
abilities.desc: Sends the hound in first and follows it.

upgrades.note: the hound grows into something you would not keep indoors
works a second hound

_abilityDoc: The abilities named by `upgrades[].ability` and not carried in the type's own `abilities` list. Kept in one table so an upgrade can hand the same trick to more than one type without repeating it.

rive.name: Rive
rive.desc: Opens a guard and leaves it open.

hold_the_line.name: Hold the Line
hold_the_line.desc: Plants, and nothing gets past them for a while.

fan_of_shafts.name: Fan of Shafts
fan_of_shafts.desc: Three at once, into whatever is bunched up.

in_the_gap.name: In the Gap
in_the_gap.desc: Finds the join in the armour.

called_down.name: Called Down
called_down.desc: Straight down, on the biggest thing in the group.

tithe.name: Tithe
tithe.desc: Takes a piece of what it kills and gives it to you.

black_chorus.name: Black Chorus
black_chorus.desc: Everything within earshot is cursed at once.

second_wind.name: Second Wind
second_wind.desc: The one they save for when it has gone badly.

ember_ring.name: Ember Ring
ember_ring.desc: A ring of fire around whatever they are aiming at.
